node.title: PMA sigma-one dyadic growing-defect near-coset owner
node.statement: For every official sigma=1 row n=2^j, put s_n=floor(n/(32j)) and canonically own every listed codeword missing at most s_n points of any dyadic coset of size L>=k-s_n. The all-scale class is smaller than 2^(7n/64)<Q_2(k+2); combined with exact periodicity it fits below 8(1+2^-690)Q_2(k+2), hence inside the existing 719 line. This contains the index-two owner, the complete reciprocal-quadratic obstruction, and every near-quotient finite PMA defect through d=s_n-1 in the worst background state.
